svg.text: BARN HALL — LOW TABLE FLOOR DINING
Communal low tables with floor cushions, seated for 56
16 sq ft per person at 900 sq ft
2 table rows x 2 runs x 14 = 56 diners
7 cushions per side of each 16'-6" run
900 sq ft / 56 = 16 sq ft per person
Low table, 30" wide x 16'-6" long, 12" high
Service aisle, 2'-6" at both long walls
Inner cushions shift up to 6" so the centerline posts
land between diners rather than behind a back.
Service reaches every seat from the perimeter aisles.
